content: We evaluate our method on several English all-words WSD datasets. For a fair comparison, we use the benchmark datasets proposed by BIBREF17 which include five standard all-words fine-grained WSD datasets from the Senseval and SemEval competitions: Senseval-2 (SE2), Senseval-3 (SE3), SemEval-2007 (SE07), SemEval-2013 (SE13) and SemEval-2015 (SE15). Following BIBREF13, BIBREF12 and BIBREF10, we choose SE07, the smallest among these test sets, as the development set.
